title: Unified gateway log panel semantics
description: Implementation-backed suggestions for dashboard authors. This file is a semantic specification, not a Kibana saved object import.
importantConstraints: Counts are observed exported log events. Logs can be filtered or dropped; they are not billing or exact-once business counters.
event.code is a string. RabbitMQ low-number event codes must be scoped by logger because .NET framework logs reuse numbers such as 103 and 105.

event6021 is one completed source handling attempt after parsing/preparation/dispatch. It excludes early missing-gridType filter6022, parse rejection6020, thrown handler exceptions and cancellation. Retries emit additional attempts.
event6021 has no pipeline.id: do not apply pipeline.id globally to source-wide panels. Dispatch and rule evaluation panels have pipeline.id.
event6001 successful delivery is Debug and has no findair.outcome field. Classify successes by event.code6001. Failure6002 is Warning and has findair.outcome retry or rejected.
Source success means handler success. An attempt with no matching rules may succeed with zero dispatches. Dispatch delivered means transport accepted it, not that the downstream algorithm completed.

Full source retries can resend previously delivered dispatch units. Distinct messaging.message.id on dispatch events is an approximate unique dispatch identity count, not an exact-once throughput measure.
event6022 includes source-wide, pipeline and run filtering. A message can produce several filter events and still dispatch work. Never label all event6022 counts as dropped messages.
rule loaded/rejected/retained count fields are snapshots, not increments. Use last value per pipeline and service.instance.id; do not sum over refreshes or replicas.
event6012 rule detail logs are capped at 10 per load. Their count is not the total number of rejected rules. Repeated refreshes report the same bad rule again.

Rule evaluation matched IDs and missed ID arrays may be truncated by the exporter MaxCollectionCount (32 by default). Numeric miss counts remain the reliable per-evaluation totals. A rule records its first failed matching condition only.
event106 confirms a successful broker nack without requeue for dead-letter routing. It does not prove the configured DLQ stored the message or measure current queue depth.
Pipeline IDs are configuration keys, conventionally FindAir and DeepWisdom; service.name may be overridden. Replace the base service filter if deployed with a different name.
service.environment in the supplied Integration screenshot is Integration with a capital I, but data_stream.namespace is integration. Use data_stream.namespace for the log environment selector.
Custom string aggregation fields may be mapped as keyword or text plus .keyword depending on installed templates. Inspect actual field capabilities before building aggregations.
Source/dispatch logs have no duration field. Use traces for latency and never invent a log duration or sum framework timings.

debugLoggingConfiguration.description: Enables gateway Debug events for Logstash (6001 delivery, 6011 refresh, 6022 filters), without turning every framework logger to Debug. The EcsHttp provider-specific level can otherwise override a global Debug setting.

recommendedControls.label: Pipeline
recommendedControls.warning: A global pipeline filter hides source-wide logs, retries and DLQ events.

panels.title: Completed source attempts
panels.description: Source handler attempts that reached completion; retries count again. Excludes early filters and parse failures.

panels.title: Source attempt outcomes over time
panels.description: Handler outcomes, not final downstream completion. No pipeline.id filter.

panels.title: Dispatch units per completed source attempt
panels.description: Counts prepared dispatch outcomes plus invalid preparations; zero includes messages with no matching runs.

panels.title: Dispatch attempts by pipeline and result [Debug needed for delivered]
panels.description: Transport attempt result, not algorithm completion; delivery events require gateway Debug logging.

panels.title: Dispatch failures by pipeline and category
panels.description: error.type is an exception class; findair.error.category is the stable failure classification.

panels.title: HTTP dispatch failure status codes
panels.description: Only failures with an HTTP response. Timeouts/connection failures may have no status code. Successful HTTP codes are available on spans, not delivery logs.

panels.title: Source retry schedules by attempt
panels.description: Successful retry publication plus source acknowledgement. Each retry is counted; does not have pipeline.id.

panels.title: Source dead-letter routing events
panels.description: Broker nack without requeue completed. This is not a DLQ depth or proof of downstream DLQ receipt.

panels.title: Dead-letter routing reasons
panels.description: Additional retry-header validation reasons can appear. The field is labels.reason, not error.message.

panels.title: Source validation rejections by code
panels.description: Common input parse/context validation failure. Pipeline-specific preparation rejections are separate logs.

panels.title: Pipeline work preparation failures
panels.description: Warning indicates contract input rejection; Error indicates an exception during preparation. ErrorCount is labels.error_count. These logs have event.code0, so category is essential.

panels.title: Filter events by reason [Debug needed]
panels.description: Filter event count with mixed source/pipeline/run granularity. It must not be labelled dropped source messages.

panels.title: Source attempts skipped: gridType not updated [Debug needed]
panels.description: One early filter event per handling attempt missing gridType in updatedFields; returned success without parsing or dispatch.

panels.title: No matching rules by pipeline [Debug needed]
panels.description: One event per evaluated pipeline with zero matched rules. Other pipelines may still receive work.

panels.title: Image-rule evaluations by pipeline
panels.description: One event per source attempt and pipeline; not one event per individual rule. Retries repeat evaluations.

panels.title: Rule comparison misses by first failed condition
panels.description: Counts rule comparisons across image attempts, not missed images or unique rules. First failed condition only.

panels.title: Latest observed rule counts per pipeline and instance [Debug needed for refresh]
panels.description: Latest observation inside selected time range, not guaranteed current state. Refresh6011 is Debug. Never sum snapshots or replicas. All-rules-rejected loads do not emit6010/6011; see failure6013.

panels.title: Rule load failures by pipeline
panels.description: Previous rules remain active during failed refreshes; startup failure prevents service startup. Retained count is a snapshot.

panels.title: Rule rejection examples (up to 10 per load)
panels.description: Diagnostic examples, not all rejected rules. The same rule may appear on every refresh.

panels.title: Exported log volume by severity
panels.description: Exported logs, not message throughput. This shows logging volume and warning/error spikes.

panels.title: RabbitMQ connection and consumer disruptions
panels.kql: log.logger: ImagingPipeline.RabbitMqClient.* and event.code: ("109" or "110" or "111" or "112" or "113" or "115")

panels.title: Recent gateway events and trace correlation
panels.description: Search by image ID to follow evaluation across pipelines; source ID may appear as messaging.message.id or conversation_id on dispatch logs. A trace ID enables correlation with APM traces when the corresponding span was sampled and exported.

panels.title: Recent warnings and errors
panels.description: A broad diagnostic table that retains exception details and message/trace identifiers.
